title: Build a Motivated-Seller Pipeline for Real Estate Deals
summary: Spot likely sellers, find owner contacts, qualify them by text and underwrite the ones that answer.

money_potential.label: High
money_potential.basis: Assumes a commission or assignment fee per closed deal, which is large but infrequent.
money_potential.note: Money tiers are our estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative earning potential, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Earlier contact with motivated sellers means better deals.
Underwriting filters out deals that do not pencil.
who_its_for: Real estate agents, wholesalers and small investors.

stack.name: Motivated Seller Finder
stack.role: Flags likely motivated sellers from property data.
stack.creator: scheemunai

stack.name: Seller Lead Skip Tracer
stack.role: Skip-traces owners and pushes leads to HubSpot.
stack.creator: Preston Zeller

stack.name: SMS Property Lead Qualifier
stack.role: Qualifies replies over SMS and logs answers.
stack.creator: Robert Breen

stack.name: Buy to Rent Property
stack.role: Underwrites the deal as a rental.
stack.creator: scheemunai

steps.name: You
steps.does: Talk to sellers and make offers

steps: Pick one market and your buy box.
Review the flagged list before any contact.
Approve the SMS script and send in small batches.
Underwrite every qualified lead before an offer.
guardrails: Check local rules on cold outreach, calls and texts before contacting anyone.
The bots never pay, sign or accept terms for you.
Handle customer and candidate data under your local privacy rules.
